status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Kigali, Kivu and Kinshasa.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Kigali, Kivu og Kinshasa.

summary.en: M23 rebels seized a major town in eastern DRC, violating a ceasefire, while ADF gunmen killed dozens of civilians in Ituri province amid the Ebola outbreak. The UN mission reinforced its presence in eastern DRC as unpaid wages and fighting stalled the Ebola response, which has reached a death toll of 5,387. Scores of Christians were killed in recent terror attacks and private military contractors are cited as a risk to mineral security. The Francophonie summit postponed the vote on a new leader after a dispute between DR Congo and Rwanda, and five EU countries announced a scheme to deport irregular migrants to Rwanda. The conflict accounted for 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: M23‑opprørerne tok kontroll over en stor by i østlige DRC, og brøt dermed en våpenhvile, mens ADF-våpnere drepte dusinvis av sivile i Ituri-provinsen under ebolautbruddet. FN-misjonen forsterket sin tilstedeværelse i østlige DRC ettersom ubetalte lønninger og kamper hindret ebolasvaret, som har nådd et dødstall på 5 387. Titalls kristne ble drept i nylige terrorangrep, og private militærkontraktører blir nevnt som en risiko for mineralsikkerheten. Francophonie-toppen utsatte avstemningen om en ny leder etter en tvist mellom DR Congo og Rwanda, og fem EU-land kunngjorde et program for å deportere irregulære migranter til Rwanda. Konflikten stod for 1 158 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: M23 campaign (2022–present)
background.extract: The M23 campaign is an ongoing series of military offensives launched by the March 23 Movement (M23), a Rwandan-backed rebel paramilitary group in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, since March 2022. In November 2021, M23 first launched attacks against the Congolese military (FARDC) and MONUSCO, seizing military positions in Ndiza, Cyanzu, and Runyoni in North Kivu Province. This coincided with the deployment of Uganda People's Defence Force (UPDF) to the region to combat the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF), a Ugandan rebel group operating in the Congo's North Kivu and Ituri provinces.
